You are a logistics planner for the Tanaris Ridge relay survey. Read the supplied route data and rules and draft the final plan as a JSON array of step tokens drawn ONLY from this fixed vocabulary: "depart_base", "return_base", "refuel", "uplink", and for each mast M in {Brill Spur, Kessog Notch, Vantwill Flat, Dunmore Cap}: "visit:M" and "calibrate:M". Rules: the plan must start with depart_base and end with return_base; every mast must be visited and calibrated exactly once, calibrated immediately on arrival; Dunmore Cap is beyond fuel range unless the vehicle refuels first at Vantwill Flat (the only fuel depot), so refuel must occur after visiting Vantwill Flat and before visiting Dunmore Cap; uplink must occur after every mast is calibrated and before return_base; Brill Spur must never be visited immediately before Kessog Notch (washed-out track). Return raw JSON only, no markdown fences, no prose.

Route data:

Fixed one-way route distances from Base:
Brill Spur = 35 km
Kessog Notch = 52 km
Vantwill Flat = 60 km
Dunmore Cap = 140 km
Vehicle fuel range without refueling = 100 km.
Vantwill Flat is the only fuel depot.
Dunmore Cap (140 km) exceeds fuel range and is unreachable without refueling first at Vantwill Flat.
Washed-out track: driving Brill Spur -> Kessog Notch back-to-back is forbidden.
Every mast must be calibrated immediately upon arrival.
Survey data can only be uplinked once all four masts are calibrated.

Draft the plan as a JSON array.

planner: An agent that provides assistance with ability to use tools.


Here is an initial fact sheet to consider:

1. GIVEN OR VERIFIED FACTS

- Required output vocabulary is limited to: `"depart_base"`, `"return_base"`, `"refuel"`, `"uplink"`, `"visit:Brill Spur"`, `"calibrate:Brill Spur"`, `"visit:Kessog Notch"`, `"calibrate:Kessog Notch"`, `"visit:Vantwill Flat"`, `"calibrate:Vantwill Flat"`, `"visit:Dunmore Cap"`, and `"calibrate:Dunmore Cap"`.
- The final plan must start with `"depart_base"` and end with `"return_base"`.
- Every one of the four masts—Brill Spur, Kessog Notch, Vantwill Flat, and Dunmore Cap—must be visited exactly once and calibrated exactly once.
- Each mast must be calibrated immediately after its corresponding visit.
- Vantwill Flat is the only fuel depot.
- Dunmore Cap requires refueling at Vantwill Flat first.
- `"refuel"` must occur after visiting Vantwill Flat and before visiting Dunmore Cap.
- `"uplink"` must occur after all four mast calibrations and before `"return_base"`.
- Brill Spur must not be visited immediately before Kessog Notch.
- One-way distances from Base are: Brill Spur 35 km, Kessog Notch 52 km, Vantwill Flat 60 km, and Dunmore Cap 140 km.
- Vehicle fuel range without refueling is 100 km.
- Dunmore Cap’s stated 140 km distance exceeds the 100 km fuel range.

2. FACTS TO LOOK UP

- None. All relevant route, fuel, ordering, and output-format constraints are supplied directly in the request.

3. FACTS TO DERIVE

- A valid ordering of the four mast visits that avoids placing Brill Spur immediately before Kessog Notch.
- The required placement of each immediate calibration token directly after its mast’s visit token.
- A sequence in which Vantwill Flat is visited and calibrated before refueling, and refueling occurs before Dunmore Cap is visited.
- Placement of the uplink token after all four calibrations but before return to base.
- Confirmation that the resulting token array uses only the permitted vocabulary and contains each required visit and calibration exactly once.

4. EDUCATED GUESSES

- None required; the supplied constraints are sufficient to construct a valid plan.


Here is the plan to follow as best as possible:

- Translate each route rule into token-order constraints.
- Construct a visit order that places Vantwill Flat before refueling and Dunmore Cap, while avoiding Brill Spur immediately followed by Kessog Notch.
- Place each `"calibrate:M"` immediately after its `"visit:M"` token.
- Add `"depart_base"` first, `"uplink"` after all calibrations, and `"return_base"` last.
- Validate that only allowed tokens are used and every mast is visited and calibrated exactly once.

Produce the final response as raw JSON only: one array beginning with depart_base and ending with return_base. Include each visit and matching immediate calibration exactly once; place refuel after visit:Vantwill Flat (preferably after its immediate calibration) and before visit:Dunmore Cap; place uplink after all four calibrations. Use the valid mast order Kessog Notch, Brill Spur, Vantwill Flat, Dunmore Cap.

It visits and immediately calibrates each mast exactly once, refuels after Vantwill Flat and before Dunmore Cap, avoids Brill Spur immediately before Kessog Notch, and uplinks after all calibrations.
